dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Seeing Aranara failing to solve the riddles, Araesha feels happy.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: If Aranara solves the riddles, Araesha feels happy.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: All in all, riddles make Aranara happy.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: But Araesha has never provided a riddle for Nara. Araesha should think again, what happy riddles will Nara like?
